Only native tool calls (write_to_file, replace_in_file) are permitted for structured JSON writes. This prevents quote-interpolation corruption that has already destroyed audit continuity in this workspace (7-cycle flat-file overwrite, nested-JSON quote corruption from powershell -Command).
